rules.name: Balance sheet must balance: total sources of funds (5) = total application of funds (5)
BS 1c total partner's / member's fund = 1a capital + 1bvi total reserves and surplus
BS 1bvi total reserves and surplus = 1bi + 1bii + 1biii + 1biv + 1bv
BS 2c total loan funds = 2aiii secured loans + 2biii unsecured loans
BS 2aiic total secured rupee loans = from banks + from others
BS 2aiii total secured loans = foreign currency loans + rupee loans
BS 2biid total unsecured rupee loans = from banks + from persons specified u/s 40A(2)(b) + from others
BS 2biii total unsecured loans = foreign currency loans + rupee loans
BS 4iii total advances = 4i from persons specified u/s 40A(2)(b) + 4ii from others
BS 5 total sources of funds = 1c + 2c + 3 deferred tax liability + 4iii advances
rules.notes: Equivalent to scenario 60 "5 = 1c + 2c + 3 + 4iii"; scenarios 57 and 64 tie the same total to the application side.

rules.name: BS 1c net block = 1a gross block − 1b depreciation
BS 1e total fixed assets = 1c net block + 1d capital work-in-progress
BS 2aii long-term equity instruments total = listed + unlisted
BS 2aviii total long-term investments = 2ai to 2avii
BS 2bi short-term equity instruments total = listed + unlisted
BS 2bvii total short-term investments = 2bi to 2bvi
BS 2c total investments = 2aviii long-term + 2bvii short-term investments

BS 3av total current assets = 3aiH inventories + 3aiiC sundry debtors + 3aiiiD cash and bank + 3aiv other current assets
BS 3biv total loans and advances = advances recoverable + deposits + balance with revenue authorities
BS 3c total current assets, loans and advances = 3av + 3biv

BS 3e net current assets = 3c total current assets, loans and advances − 3diii total current liabilities and provisions
BS 4d total miscellaneous adjustments = 4a miscellaneous expenditure + 4b deferred tax asset + 4c accumulated losses

Manufacturing 1Aiii total opening inventory = 1Ai raw material + 1Aii work-in-progress
Manufacturing 1Div total direct expenses = 1Di carriage inward + 1Dii power and fuel + 1Diii other direct expenses
Manufacturing 1Evii total factory overheads = 1Ei to 1Evi
